en.title: Hurricane 'Simon' intensifies to category 3
en.summary: Hurricane Simon strengthened to category 3 with maximum sustained winds of 195 km/h, located 245 kilometers south of Manzanillo.

stories.title: Gobierno de Venezuela firma acuerdo con SpaceX para desplegar el servicio de Starlink en el país

en.title: Venezuela government signs agreement with SpaceX to deploy Starlink service in the country
en.summary: Venezuela reached an accord with SpaceX enabling users to contract Starlink internet service directly, manage payments through local banking networks, and receive equipment at home.

stories.title: Terremoto en Panamá de magnitud 7.7 deja al menos dos heridos y edificios colapsados

en.title: Earthquake in Panama with magnitude 7.7 leaves at least two injured and collapsed buildings
en.summary: A 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck Panama, resulting in at least two injuries and building collapses, followed by more than 100 aftershocks including some of magnitude 6.

stories.title: Reportan daños materiales y heridos en epicentro de terremoto en Panamá; "hay miedo por réplicas"

en.title: Material damage and injuries reported at Panama earthquake epicenter; 'fear over aftershocks'
en.summary: A Panama earthquake centered 10 kilometers deep near Tonosí caused material damage and injuries, with residents expressing concern about continued aftershocks.

stories.title: Huracán Isaías toca tierra en Florida; deja 512 mil clientes sin electricidad

en.title: Hurricane Isaías makes landfall in Florida; leaves 512,000 customers without electricity
en.summary: Hurricane Isaías touched down in Florida with maximum winds near 170 kilometers per hour, causing over half a million customers to lose power.

stories.title: Economía firma acuerdo con empresa para crear bases de dirigibles y una escuela de pilotos; prevén inversión de 300 mdd

en.title: Economy signs agreement with company to create airship bases and pilot school; plan investment of 300 million dollars
en.summary: Mexico's economy ministry reached an accord to establish three airship manufacturing bases and a pilot training school in the country with an anticipated investment of 300 million dollars.

stories.title: Isaías toca tierra como huracán de categoría 2 en las costas de EU

en.title: Isaías makes landfall as Category 2 hurricane on US coasts
en.summary: Hurricane Isaías struck near Destin, Florida with maximum sustained winds of 165 kilometers per hour, according to the National Hurricane Center.

stories.title: Manifestantes protestan en Nueva York contra el ICE por operativo que dejó herido a un dominicano

en.title: Protesters rally in New York against ICE over operation that wounded a Dominican
en.summary: A 28-year-old Dominican man was injured in the neck during an ICE operation in the Bronx, prompting protests in New York against the agency.

stories.title: Activan alerta amarilla por lluvias fuertes en toda la CDMX; se esperan precipitaciones hasta las 2:00 de la mañana del sábado 10 de octubre

en.title: Yellow alert activated for heavy rains across Mexico City; precipitation expected until 2:00 AM Saturday, October 10
en.summary: Civil protection authorities issued a yellow alert for Mexico City due to heavy rainfall expected until early Saturday, October 10, and provided recommendations to residents.

stories.title: Huracán Simón deja inundaciones y mar de fondo en Acapulco a pocas horas de tocar tierra

en.title: Hurricane Simón causes flooding and rough seas in Acapulco hours before making landfall
en.summary: Hurricane Simón is bringing flooding and dangerous surf conditions to Acapulco while tracking northward toward Puerto Vallarta.

stories.title: Simon es huracán de categoría 1; causa inundaciones en Acapulco

en.title: Simon is a category 1 hurricane; causes flooding in Acapulco
en.summary: Hurricane Simon, which intensified from a tropical storm, caused severe flooding in various areas of Acapulco due to heavy rainfall.

stories.title: Riña en penal de Sinaloa deja 9 reos y un menor muertos

en.title: Prison Fight in Sinaloa Leaves 9 Inmates and One Child Dead
en.summary: A riot at El Castillo penitentiary in Mazatlán, Sinaloa resulted in nine inmate deaths and one visiting two-year-old child killed, along with 16 other inmates injured.

stories.title: Antes de Chivas y Omnilife, Jorge Vergara se levantaba a las 4:00 de la mañana para vender carnitas

en.title: Before Chivas and Omnilife, Jorge Vergara woke at 4:00 AM to sell carnitas
en.summary: Jorge Vergara faced financial failure early in his career and sold carnitas in the early morning hours before founding his successful companies Chivas and Omnilife.

stories.title: Videos muestran el potente sismo de magnitud 7.7 que sacudió Panamá y provocó pánico entre la población

en.title: Videos show powerful 7.7 magnitude earthquake that shook Panama and caused panic among the population
en.summary: A 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck Panama, triggering evacuations in the capital and generating several aftershocks that kept residents on alert.

stories.title: Los empleos que EU perdió con Yokohama reaparecen en un caso laboral contra México

en.title: Jobs lost in the US with Yokohama reappear in labor case against Mexico
en.summary: Nearly 600 jobs disappeared in Virginia when Yokohama moved production to Saltillo, and this case is now under review in a labor rights file before the USTR.

stories.title: La historia nadie conoce de la crema Teatrical: pasó por Sanborns, la compró Slim y acabó en manos de Rodrigo Herrera

en.title: The Unknown History of Teatrical Cream: Passed Through Sanborns, Bought by Slim and Ended in Rodrigo Herrera's Hands
en.summary: Teatrical, a cream brand founded in 1928 that featured actress Silvia Pinal as a key ambassador, is now part of a major Mexican consumer goods group after changing ownership multiple times.

stories.title: La planta de Heineken en Orizaba cumple 130 años y hoy usa la IA para gestionar su recurso más valioso

en.title: Heineken's Orizaba Plant Reaches 130 Years and Now Uses AI to Manage Its Most Valuable Resource
en.summary: Heineken's brewery in Orizaba celebrates 130 years of operation and implements artificial intelligence to manage resources while producing 26% of Mexico's beer with efficient water usage.
